name: Constelação panorâmica
prompt: High-fidelity 16:10 desktop homepage for a Brazilian Law course in the same engineering tensegrity world. Cool pale concrete canvas with quiet blueprint marks. Slender header, large ESTUDOS DE DIREITO title, then a full-width adaptive Atomium curriculum made from exactly four oversized discipline atoms with carbon rods and red tension cords. Use short codes IED, ETI, PEN, CON and leader lines to the full discipline names. Below, an aligned linear accessible register repeats the same four disciplines without cards. Include the note: A constelação representa o curso — não relações de pré-requisito. The network looks data-driven and capable of rebalancing when disciplines change. No topic names, no subthemes, no fake dashboard metrics, no legal clichés, warm beige magazine styling, gradients, neon, glassmorphism, photos or people.
